# Linktree

> Linktree is a link-in-bio tool used by 70M+ creators, brands, and businesses
to share everything they create, curate, and sell from a single URL. This file
lists publicly indexable, logged-out pages of https://linktr.ee/ that describe
the product, pricing, marketplace, help content, and company information.
Individual user profiles at https://linktr.ee/{username} are not enumerated here;
see the sitemaps referenced below for the full crawlable surface.

Linktree is operated by Linktree Pty Ltd. The core product lets users build a
mobile-friendly landing page that aggregates their social profiles, content,
products, and services behind a single URL. Paid plans (Starter, Pro, Premium)
add customization, analytics, commerce, scheduling, and AI features.

Notes for agents:

- User profile pages (`https://linktr.ee/{username}`) are public, server-rendered
HTML and are not listed in this file. They are discoverable via the sitemaps referenced
in `/robots.txt`.

- The Help Center is hosted on Intercom and is crawlable from `https://linktr.ee/help`.
- The blog is published at `https://linktr.ee/blog` and organized by category.
- The Marketplace lists third-party apps and integrations that creators can add to their Linktree.
- See also: https://linktr.ee/robots.txt and the sitemaps listed within it.

## Product

- [Home](https://linktr.ee/): Overview of Linktree, the link-in-bio product, and core value proposition.
- [Pricing](https://linktr.ee/s/pricing/): Free, Starter, Pro, and Premium plan tiers with monthly and annual billing.
- [Link in bio](https://linktr.ee/link-in-bio/): What a link-in-bio is and how Linktree implements it.
- [Templates](https://linktr.ee/templates): Gallery of example Linktree profiles used as templates.
- [Creator hub](https://linktr.ee/s/creator/): Overview of Linktree for creators, with product and monetization features.
- [Linktree for Instagram](https://linktr.ee/s/creator/linktree-for-instagram/): How creators use Linktree to extend their Instagram bio.
- [Linktree for LinkedIn](https://linktr.ee/s/creator/linktree-for-linkedin/): How professionals use Linktree to extend their LinkedIn profile.
- [Linktree for Pinterest](https://linktr.ee/s/creator/linktree-for-pinterest/): How creators use Linktree to extend their Pinterest profile.
- [Linktree for musicians](https://linktr.ee/s/creator/linktree-for-musicians/): How musicians use Linktree to share and promote their work.
- [Linktree for e-commerce](https://linktr.ee/s/linktree-for-ecommerce/): How online sellers use Linktree to drive traffic and sales.
- [Linktree for small business](https://linktr.ee/s/linktree-for-smb/): How small businesses use Linktree as a lightweight web presence.
- [Creator Report](https://linktr.ee/creator-report/): Annual research report on the state of the creator economy.

## Marketplace

- [Marketplace](https://linktr.ee/marketplace): Directory of apps and integrations that extend Linktree profiles.
- [Link Apps](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/apps): Embeddable apps (music, video, commerce, contact, etc.).
- [Integrations](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/integrations): Third-party service integrations (Shopify, TikTok, YouTube, etc.).
- [Browse all](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/browse): Full index of available apps and integrations.
- [Share content apps](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/categories/share-content): Apps for sharing music, video, and social content.
- [Make money apps](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/categories/make-money): Apps for selling products, fundraising, and monetization.
- [Grow following apps](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/categories/grow-following): Apps for audience growth and contact capture.
- [Developer program](https://linktr.ee/marketplace/developer): Information for developers building on the Linktree platform.
